name: The Ritz-Carlton, Guangzhou
positioning: Luxury hotel in the center of Pearl River New City, Guangzhou, with rooms looking over the Pearl River or the city skyline
best_for: Travelers who want a riverside base near the Guangzhou Opera House
Guests who want a Michelin-starred Cantonese dinner at the hotel
Families interested in the Ritz Kids program

facts.text: The hotel is in the center of Pearl River New City, Guangzhou.
Rooms and suites have a standalone tub and ceiling-to-floor windows with views of the Pearl River or the Guangzhou skyline.
The hotel unveiled its upgraded Club and Suite in July 2021.
Lai Heen, the hotel's signature Cantonese restaurant, has retained its Michelin star consecutively since the inaugural Michelin Guide Guangzhou in 2018.
FOODS offers an Asian and Western buffet with live cooking stations.
The Churchill Bar has an extensive single-malt whisky collection, imported cigars, signature cocktails, live entertainment and billiards.
Pearl Lounge serves afternoon tea with savouries and desserts.
The spa includes a fitness center and a heated outdoor swimming pool.
The Ritz-Carlton Spa has 8 treatment rooms.
The Guangzhou Opera House, designed by Zaha Hadid, is a brief stroll across the promenade from the hotel.
